title: FUTABA
en: A sign once read: "Nuclear power, energy for a bright future."
The sign stood at the entrance to the town of Futaba.
Nearby stood the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear plant.
On 11 March 2011, after the earthquake and tsunami, three of the plant's reactors melted down.
About 150,000 people, including the people of Futaba, had to leave their homes.
For years, the streets here stayed empty.
At the plant, more than a thousand tanks filled up with radioactive water.
And the ground was frozen to make a wall of ice.
Cleaning up the plant will take thirty to forty years.
